# The CLI Restaurant

> Open-source Python project by Ryan Editraj: a command-line restaurant order pad and a Flask table-reservation website.

This repository is a small restaurant-management demo. It is not a hosted restaurant, it does not take payment, and it does not sell food. Reservations are not stored in a database. When email is configured, a booking or an order is sent to the address in the server environment.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/The-CLI-Restaurant/blob/main/README.md): Install, usage, features, FAQ, and screenshots
- [Security policy](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/The-CLI-Restaurant/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability
- [Contributing](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/The-CLI-Restaurant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Local setup, tests, and pull requests
- [License](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/The-CLI-Restaurant/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT

## Run

- Table booking website: `python server.py`, then open http://127.0.0.1:5000
- Terminal orders: `python The-Cli-Restaurant.py`
- New menu-item snippet: `python new-product.py`
- Optional Flask-Mail demo: `python app.py`

## Routes

- `/` reservation page
- `/sign-up` stub, returns "not available"
- `/robots.txt`
- `/sitemap.xml` host-aware when the app is running
- `/llms.txt`
- `/.well-known/security.txt`
